CVE-2026-83613.why: mammoth parses .docx knowledge-base uploads with xmldom's DOMParser, so a crafted document can stall or exhaust the queue worker (denial of service only). Reached only when a member of the admin group uploads a crafted file to the knowledge base, which needs the optional AI assistant installed (it is not on hrossen). Admins already control the Docker socket, so the realistic threat is a crafted document passed to an admin, and code run in this container is root on the VM. Risk here: low. Action: upstream must bump mammoth's @xmldom/xmldom to 0.8.15 or later. Verified live on hrossen with project-nomad:v1.35.1.
